## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain why the change is needed and what a receiver or reviewer can do after it.

## Validation

Describe meaningful tests and any remaining manual check. If matching changed, summarize per-case evaluation differences, including errors and abstentions.

## Boundaries

Identify any changed data flow, approval control, model, integration contract, dependency, or license. State what is simulated or unmeasured.

- [ ] Source and fixtures contain no secrets or operational data.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and data/model definitions match the implementation.
- [ ] No live inventory or external communication is triggered by tests or default configuration.
